page.layout: One page of running text. Running head at top left, page number at top right. Margin note in the right margin beside the line "Hanc Dallæi conjecturam".

main_text.p: tiorem olere : eò delendam putavit, nè perso-nati Ignatij drama proderet. Hanc Dallæi Pearf. p. 27. 28. conjecturam ridet Pearsonius, etsi omni prorsùs verisimilitudine non careat : nec obstat quod scribit Vindiciarum Auctor, non ita sibi cavisse Interpolatorem, quin plura loquutus sit, quæ tria post Valentinum sæcula saperent ; fateor planos & impostores non semper sibi cavere, nec ita rebus suis prospicere, vt nihil eis planè excidat quod illorum adversetur proposito ; sed fateri debet etiam Vir doctus non malè aliquando rebus suis providere istiusmodi [illegible, ~2 letters]nfarcinatores, & ea sæpissimè expunge[illegible, ~2 letters] solere, quæ eorum judicio impostura prodere possent, fraudémque aperire, quæ sibi nocere putant isti homines eradunt, vel saltem ea ad suum propositum suffectis alijs verbis detorquere conantur ; quæ sibi adversari non animadvertunt, prætereunt, vel si aliquâ sollicitantur suspicione, ea aliquomodo incrustata & immutata propinant, sed quia deest illis in pluribus sagacitas atque solertia ingenij acumen, rerumque multarum notitia ; fieri non potest quin edant alicubi figmentorum suorum specimina, & seipsos fraudis & impostura reos agant ; sic se gessit Ignatianarum Epistolarum interpolator, qui

page.notes: An ink blot covers the middle of lines 14 to 16 (istiusmodi, expungere). The words "infarcinatores" and "expungere" are only partly legible; the visible letters are "nfarcinatores" and "expunge". Spelling of "impostura" in the blot-free text is as printed ("impofturam" with long s). Long s is written as plain s throughout. Running head and page number are at the top of the page. The margin note "Pearf. p. 27. 28." stands in the right margin.
